answer: Honest result: Uncertainty — do not invent an ADR (§15.7). docs/public/anvil/operations/security.md states Anvil is local-first: local checks do not need to upload source code; GCTX is identity-only by default; snippet egress needs explicit consent; once a snippet reaches an AI client, Anvil's local-first boundary does not extend into that provider. plans/specs/2026-09-08-context-compiler.md §15 open decision 7 (Synthesis models under local-first constraints / §15.7) asks what may run on-box, what may not leave the machine, and how that sits with Anvil's existing data boundary — and leaves it as an owner call before Ready; no ADR is filed with the draft. The module Out of Scope already forbids cross-customer learning from private source, but that is not a decided product-compiler architecture for synthesis models. Visible uncertainty: parked §15.7; do not invent an ADR in this spike.
